Thanks for catching a content issue. The more specific you are, the faster it
can be fixed.

## What kind of content?

- [ ] Lesson (Markdown)
- [ ] MCQ
- [ ] Coding problem
- [ ] SQL problem
- [ ] Pattern (in `src/data/patterns.json`)
- [ ] Mock test format / section
- [ ] Other: ____

## Track

<!-- python / dsa / sql / aptitude -->

## Topic

<!-- e.g. sliding-window, joins, time-speed-work, comprehensions, two-pointers -->

## Item / lesson ID

<!--
  e.g. python-08-comprehensions, dsa-two-sum, sql-joins-04, apt-time-work-12.
  Visible in the URL or in the lesson frontmatter (`id:` field).
-->

## URL

<!-- Paste the full URL of the broken item, e.g.
     https://smokyclaw-trainer.vercel.app/track/python/python-08-comprehensions
-->

## What's wrong?

<!-- Be precise. "The formula is wrong" is hard to act on; "the formula uses
     A = P(1 + r/100)^n but it should be A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)" is fixable. -->

## What is the correct content?

<!-- If you know, paste the correct version. -->

## Source / reference

<!-- Optional. Where did you verify the correct answer? LeetCode link,
     textbook chapter, official docs, etc. -->

## Severity

<!-- minor (typo, formatting) / significant (wrong answer, misleading) /
     critical (the problem is unsolvable as stated) -->

## Anything else?

<!-- Related issues, screenshots, etc. -->
